records.message: Swift RuntimeClient.prepare delegates complete Invocation draft JSON to the injected transport and projects daemon-provided PreparedInvocation signing material without deriving canonical bytes.
Swift rejects PreparedInvocation submission before transport; only SignedInvocation is accepted by submitSigned.
Swift SignedInvocation preserves caller signature material and daemon-provided canonical bytes when submitSigned serializes the envelope.
Swift stream/bidi handles preserve idempotent close, keep bidi receive active after closeSend, and reject sends after closeSend with CANCELLED.
Swift builds directory.subscribe carriers, projects subscription state, and opens injected Runtime Core stream handles without facade fanout.
Swift ReceiptClient builds invocation.history.get carriers from complete request tuples and exactly one selector.
Swift receipt projection refuses summary-only cryptographic claims and requires explicit receipt_ura plus receipt_hash_hex for causal refs.
Swift Events builds directory stream carriers, projects event/drop/terminal frames, and opens Runtime Core-backed event streams without SDK-local fanout.
Swift Events builds device and invocation subscription carriers and projects bounded device event history pages over injected transports.
Swift Events requires explicit daemon session_id and rejects product session_ura parsing for session streams.

Swift Publication builds daemon-authored resource refs, validates package manifests, builds deploy/unpublish Invocation carriers, and rejects relative paths, reserved namespaces, and incomplete carriers over injected transports.

Swift Mission builds complete run/run-file/track/cancel/events carriers, projects daemon MissionStatus and MissionEventPage facts, validates opaque mission ids and receipt-backed child Invocation facts, and adapts live events through Runtime Core streams.

Swift Admin + Gateway builds agent/session lifecycle Invocation carriers, projects daemon GatewayStatus, agent records, lifecycle results, pairing facts, device credentials, and device sessions, rejects system-agent lifecycle leakage, and leaves product session policy outside the SDK.

Swift Host Binding builds host-stream binding requests, decodes request envelopes, projects item/error/terminal frames, validates output-hash cursor state, and drives explicit readiness/cleanup lifecycle providers over injected transports.
Swift Surface builds page list/create/delete/manifest/health carriers, projects page records/manifests/public refs/health, and keeps rendering outside the SDK.

Swift Compatibility builds OpenAI-compatible model/chat Invocation carriers, projects model/chat/stream/file DTOs over injected transports, and leaves HTTP auth, quota, billing, storage, and fanout outside the SDK.
Swift Wrappers project file, terminal, remote desktop, browser, and media session records over injected transports while leaving HTTP/WebSocket bridge policy outside the SDK.
Swift invocation-facing descriptor refs come from Identity projection helpers rather than facade grammar assembly.

Swift declares Runtime Core, Health, Directory + Identity, Receipt, Publication, Host Binding, Mission, Admin + Gateway, Events, Surface, Compatibility, and Wrappers P1 seams and keeps provider/product cutover outside the facade.

Swift seam exposes lifecycle, invocation, runtime transport, AsyncSequence stream/bidi handles, Health DTO/client state, Directory + Identity request/projection/subscription state, Receipt request/ref/projection state, Publication carrier/resource-ref state, Host Binding codec/hash/lifecycle state, Mission carrier/status/event state, Admin + Gateway carrier/status/session state, Events carrier/frame/stream state, Surface page/manifest/health state, Compatibility carrier/projection state, Wrappers record projection state, and typed errors only.
Swift profile-specific operations outside directly declared seam clients remain unsupported.
